description: This Java class 'PlaceholderSubstitution' provides functionality for applying placeholder substitutions on objects implementing 'WithDittoHeaders'. It creates instances with default or extended replacement definitions, and applies substitution strategies based on header information. It utilizes an algorithm and a strategy registry to perform conditional substitutions asynchronously.
